One log or trace message shall be r epresented by one DltMessage element.
The Message ID shall be set in DltMessage . messageId

The D LT message is described with the following information:  Message Type (MSTP) – shall be derived from DltMessage . messageTypeInfo  Message Info (MSIN) – DltMessage . messageTypeInfo  Application ID (APID) – DltLogChannel . applicationId  Context ID (CTID) – DltLogChannel . contextId  Source file – DltMessage . messageSourceFi le  line number – D…
The user data of the log or trace message shall be represented by DltArgument s that are ordered in the DltMessage .
If the argument contains only static text, this text shall be placed in the DESC element of the DltArgument . In this case the DltArgument . length shall be set to zero.

If the argument contains n on - s tatic d ata , the data trans ported in the message is described by the DltArgument . length and by the aggregated networkRepresentation that defines the unit and the baseType.
The timer shall start with ‘00000000’ when the ECU which generates the LogMessage starts up.
The Dlt module shall be able to buffer data coming from calls to Dlt_SendLogMessag e and/or Dlt_SendTraceMessage even if the Dlt module has not been initialized yet.

As soon as the Dlt module is initialized by Dlt_Init and the optional timer DltGeneralStartUpDelayTimer has expired, all the log and trace data, which has been buffered meanwhile, shall be processed accordin g to SWS_Dlt_00651, using the configured filter settings .
The Dlt module shall remember the relation between the registered tuple of ApplicationId/ContextId, and the port interface where this tuple is registered.
Port defined a rgument v alues shall be u sed by the Dlt module as SessionIds .

The port defined arg ument value corresponds to the defined Specification of Diagnostic Log and Trace AUTOSAR CP R22 - 11 18 o f 149 Document ID 351 : AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticLogAndTrace SessionID . The value shall start at 0x1000 (for BSW modules the module ID is taken).

The Dlt module shall provide the implementation of the hook functions for every configured event given by an BswModuleEntry , which owns a shortname starting with “Rte_Dlt” provided by the BswModuleDefinition of the RTE.
MessageId s used for D EM (0x00000001) and D ET (0x00000002) , and Trace Messages (0x 0000000 3) are reserved and therefore not usable for SW - Cs.

Storing the current configuration to N v RAM shall only be done if the parameter DltGeneralNvRAMSupport is enabled and the storing has been explicitly request ed by the Dlt Command “StoreConfiguration”.
